== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Zero Hour / Liberation Of Lothal (Errata)]] (PC-E1), Virtual Set 19, as the PC published it on 18 September 2022, taken unchanged from the PC's card-image repository ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/aec517c83bf4b5a16c8b0b4a4efe78f5f8e314cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Light/large/liberationoflothal.gif holotable commit aec517c], file <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Light/large/liberationoflothal.gif</code>; a PNG file served under a .gif name). Not a recreation.
